verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a public pricing page describing plan tiers and included features (scanning, forwarding, unlimited cloud storage), and it states check deposits are pay-per-deposit with no setup or monthly fees. However, the evidence shows no dollar amounts, scan allowances or per-item fee schedule. missing for 10: actual monthly plan prices, per-plan scan allowances, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage and check deposit, and independent corroboration that the pricing is complete.

support.subject: As a founder, plan pricing is public and complete — monthly price, scan allowances, and the per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage, and check deposit

citations.quote: Choose a plan that grows with you—whether you need a secure online mailbox, a home address for personal accounts, or a physical office address with lease agreements and utility bills
Mail scanning, forwarding, and unlimited cloud storage. Access your mail 24/7 from any device
Pay per deposit with no setup or monthly fees.
